set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- The build declares whether each of core, laws, packed, and stencil is published for the core 1.0 tag.
- The recommended default publishes only core JVM and Scala.js artifacts.
- Laws, packed, and stencil use publish skip or a demonstrably separate 0.x release line.
- Local snapshot publication cannot assign 1.0 to experimental artifacts accidentally.
- Documentation, artifact names, and release notes match the enforced matrix.
- A build-level test or inspection fails when a nonselected module becomes publishable.
set.title: Enforce the core 1.0 module publication matrix
